score.note: The recollection only restates title-level details about temperature variation, Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni alloys, and single crystals. Dislocation glide is broadly relevant, but the mention of twinning is unsupported and misses the specific mechanisms: thermally activated glide, phonon-drag-controlled inertial dulling, MSAD-controlled strengthening, and Cottrell-type solute pinning. No quantitative results are recalled.
